operational_states.HEALTHY: Successful component execution; not measured financial alpha

stages.source: Provider-result status and provenance; aged capture stale
stages.bronze: Persisted native payload/hash; old healthy/degraded stale
stages.silver: Canonical quality PASS/WARN/FAIL with row/source metadata; old healthy/degraded stale
stages.gold: Completed deterministic features/model references; partial output remains explicit
stages.intelligence: Successful Gold completion HEALTHY, research-only limitation separate
stages.news: Whole Tavily/Yahoo/RSS result: fresh/no-evidence HEALTHY, unavailable FAILED, aged >900s STALE; Tavily health separate
stages.agents: Snapshot-specific team mapping: complete healthy, partial degraded, failed failed, active running, expired stale
stages.fusion: Recorded deterministic run HEALTHY irrespective of MIXED/insufficient financial view; age >3600s or wrong current snapshot STALE

unknown_values: Null, never fabricated zero latency; fallback news does not inherit Tavily latency
